usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI PA.NUS.FCRF (official exchange rate, 2025 average)
usdRate.note: Banque du Liban has held the rate at about LBP 89,500 per dollar since 2024; Trading Economics shows 89,560 on 30 October 2026. bdl.gov.lb refused automated access.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Administration of Statistics, Consumer Prices - September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: CPI up 17.53% on September 2025 (released 21 October 2026); 16.7% in August per Trading Economics. World Bank 2025 average 14.6%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: CAS CPI 17.5% (Sep 2026); World Bank 2025 average 14.6%; exchange rate held near LBP 89,500 per dollar since 2023
inflation_projection.note: With the pound held stable against the dollar since 2023, prices should drift toward dollar inflation over time, but double-digit inflation persists, so 8% (well below the current rate, well above dollar inflation) is used; the 5-year average (hyperinflation of 2021-2023) is not a usable guide.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Lebanon interest rate (Banque du Liban data)
policy_rate.note: Benchmark rate 25% (latest reading July 2026); secondary source because bdl.gov.lb refused automated access. Banque du Liban manages the currency mainly through its exchange-rate policy, so this rate has little effect on deposit rates.

savings_account_rate.note: No published typical savings account rate was found; Banque du Liban pages refused automated access. Since the 2019 crisis, old deposits are largely frozen and new ('fresh') deposits earn little.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rate was found; Banque du Liban statistics pages refused automated access.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rate was found; Banque du Liban statistics pages refused automated access.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Lebanon deposit interest rate (Banque du Liban data)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate paid by commercial banks on deposits, 4.55% in July 2026 (5.19% in June); secondary source because bdl.gov.lb refused access. The page does not say whether it covers pound or dollar deposits; far below the 25% policy rate because the central bank steers the currency through the exchange rate, not interest rates.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond sold to individuals was found in Lebanon; government debt is sold as treasury bills and bonds through Banque du Liban auctions, mainly to banks.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Lebanese pound treasury bills are auctioned by Banque du Liban for the Ministry of Finance, but bdl.gov.lb and finance.gov.lb refused automated access and no recent 3-month yield was found.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No current 5-year Lebanese pound bond yield was found; Banque du Liban pages refused automated access.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year yield was found; Lebanon's dollar Eurobonds have been in default since March 2020 and Trading Economics shows no Lebanon bond yield.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Lebanon: income determination (reviewed 1 July 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: 10% withholding tax on income from movable capital, which includes interest; PwC's personal income page says Law 144 (2019 budget) raised the interest tax from 7%.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Lebanon has no retail government savings certificate; PwC lists treasury bill and bond interest under movable capital income taxed at 10%, but no savings-certificate tax applies.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: The National Institute for the Guarantee of Deposits covers bank deposits, but its website did not resolve and no official page with the current limit in pounds could be read.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate was found; Banque du Liban circulars could not be read (access refused).

equity_return_low.sourceName: Beirut Stock Exchange main index (Trading Economics): about 1,648 in early Nov 2026, down 18.6% in a year and about 40% below its January 2025 high
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the small Beirut market (a handful of bank and property shares) keeps its weak record and earns about half the deposit rate.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Beirut Stock Exchange main index (Trading Economics); average deposit rate 4.55% less 10% tax = 4.1%
equity_return_base.note: Base case kept within 2 points of the after-tax deposit rate because the local index is tiny, illiquid and has a weak record; shares there are priced in dollars.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Beirut Stock Exchange main index (Trading Economics); long-run global equity returns
equity_return_high.note: High case: a diversified (largely foreign) equity holding earning global equity returns of about 8-9% with a stable pound.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); pound held near 89,500 per dollar
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely gains after the 2025-26 spike and the pound stays fixed.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); pound stable since 2023
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises with world inflation plus a little, with some allowance for renewed pound weakness.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); history of pound devaluation
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold plus renewed pound depreciation; gold has protected Lebanese savers through past currency collapses.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Average deposit rate 4.55% (Jul 2026) less 10% tax, falling from 5.19% in June
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates keep falling as they did in mid-2026.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case slightly below the current after-tax average deposit rate, which is trending down.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: deposit rates return to their June 2026 level.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry life claim settlement ratio from the Insurance Control Commission was found; its website could not be reached.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, but no published premium rates per LBP 1,000 of cover by age were found from the regulator or another public source; most cover is priced in US dollars.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No official figure for the typical out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found; the Ministry of Public Health publishes hospital tariffs for the cases it covers, but no typical patient cost.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium table per LBP 100,000 of cover was found; private health plans are sold in US dollars.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: CAS CPI 17.5% (Sep 2026); health prices repriced in dollars after the crisis
goal_inflation_health.note: Health costs (hospitals and medicines largely priced in dollars) are assumed to rise faster than the 8% headline planning rate; CAS did not publish a health sub-index in its September release.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: CAS CPI 17.5% (Sep 2026); private school and university fees largely in dollars
goal_inflation_education.note: Education (mostly private schools and universities charging partly in dollars) is assumed to rise a little faster than the 8% headline planning rate.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 76.2, women 80.1 (UN WPP estimate for 2026, mid-year); World Bank 2024 figure 77.9. Re-checked on georank 2026-11-03.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 16.3 (2025, World Bank), 22.9 (2040) and 29.6 (2065, populationpyramid.net/lebanon/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: Private employees receive a lump-sum end-of-service indemnity from the National Social Security Fund rather than a pension; Law 319 of 2023 creates a pension system, but no official page giving the pension age could be read (cnss.gov.lb did not show it).

retirement_age_government.note: No official page stating the current retirement age for civil servants could be read.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Average deposit rate 4.55% (Jul 2026) less 10% tax, falling
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates keep falling.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the after-tax average deposit rate, as no treasury bill yield was found.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: deposit rates recover to their June 2026 level.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: After-tax deposits about 4.1%; weak record of the Beirut Stock Exchange index
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares and deposit rates both disappoint.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: After-tax deposits 3.5% base; equity base 6%; gold base 5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of deposits, gold and shares at about 5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning mix with foreign shares and gold.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension that a person can claim today was confirmed; means-tested cash assistance from the Ministry of Social Affairs exists, but no old-age amount could be read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension with published eligibility ages was confirmed.

gratuity_rule.note: Private employees covered by the National Social Security Fund receive an end-of-service indemnity based on last wage and years of service (employer contribution 5% of earnings per PwC), but the formula could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.note: Law 319 of 2023 replaces the NSSF end-of-service indemnity with a pension system for private employees, but its pension age, indexation and start date could not be read from an official source; cnss.gov.lb did not show them.

savings_account.note: Most new savings are held in 'fresh' US dollars; old pre-2019 deposits remain largely frozen.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit scheme with published rates was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by Banque du Liban, mainly to banks.

tbond_5y.note: Mainly held by banks; no current yield found.

tbond_10y.note: Lebanon's dollar Eurobonds have been in default since March 2020; no 10-year bond is being issued.

equity_fund.note: No diversified local retail mutual or index fund was confirmed; the Beirut Stock Exchange lists only a few shares.

gold.note: Physical gold is freely bought and sold.

insuranceRegulator.name: Insurance Control Commission (Ministry of Economy and Trade)
insuranceRegulator.note: The commission's own website could not be reached during research.

insuranceComplaints.name: Insurance Control Commission (Ministry of Economy and Trade)

pensionScheme.name: الصندوق الوطني للضمان الاجتماعي (National Social Security Fund)
pensionScheme.note: Pays the end-of-service indemnity; Law 319 of 2023 introduces a pension system.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Public Health (hospital care for the uninsured)

statistics.name: إدارة الإحصاء المركزي (Central Administration of Statistics)
